newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Rates quoted at thin levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Rates quoted at thin levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at thin levels Thursday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none Wednesday.
- Four barges, St Paul-Savage, upper Mississippi River, one each week of July, bid 135 percent of tariff, unchanged from July 2, no offer.
- Five barges, Osceola through Cairo, Mississippi, one each week of August, bid 95 percent, no comparison, no offer.
There will be no call session on July 4 in observance of U.S. Independence Day.
